snippet.title: Legends of Hearts - Official Co-op Trailer (Like It Takes Two!)
snippet.description:
Grab a friend and jump into Legends of Hearts, a heartwarming cooperative adventure built in the spirit of It Takes Two! This 2.5D co-op game brings families and friends together to solve puzzles, avoid traps, and explore a magical world. No violence. No gambling. Just pure co-op fun.

🎮 Wishlist on Epic Games & Steam: Coming Soon
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/kvJdpfnWZT
🐦 Follow us on X: https://x.com/LOH_Online
🌐 Official Website: https://legendsofhearts.com/

About Legends of Hearts:
We are building a family-friendly cooperative experience where characters and weapons are rendered in beautiful 3D, set against a charming 2.5D backdrop. Team up with a friend, master the mechanics, and ring the bell!

Subscribe to our channel for more updates, devlogs, and exclusive gameplay trailers as we prepare for our playable demo!

#LegendsOfHearts #CoopGames #IndieGame #ItTakesTwo #Platformer #GameTrailer
